name: prettier-plugin-slurp
description: Prettier plugin that formats .slurp template files.
author: ByteSell LLC
//devDependencies: @slurp/language is a BUILD-time dependency, not a runtime one. tsup.config.ts sets noExternal on it, so it is bundled into dist/index.js, which imports nothing but prettier/doc. It must not sit in `dependencies`: it is `private: true` and will never exist on npm, so a published manifest naming it resolves to a version that 404s forever.
